title: Juicy Greek Bananas Tart
description: A pungent and energizing Greek dessert featuring bananas and a creamy mascarpone-custard filling. This tart is perfect for low-carb diets and is a delightful twist on traditional Greek desserts.
instructions: Roll out the pastry dough and place it into a 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom.
In a medium bowl, whisk together mascarpone cheese, eggs, honey, walnuts, lemon zest, vanilla extract, and salt until smooth.
Arrange the sliced bananas on top of the pastry dough, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Brush the edges of the pastry dough with the beaten egg and fold the edges to form a crust.
Pour the mascarpone mixture over the bananas and smooth the top.
Dot the top of the tart with the unsalted butter.
Bake for 40 minutes, or until the pastry crust is golden brown and the filling is set.
Let the tart cool completely on a wire rack before dusting with icing sugar.
Serve warm or at room temperature, sliced into wedges.
Keep any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
